item.title: Ted Carter Confident in Jake Diebler Amid Ohio State’s NCAA Tournament Push, Wants Buckeyes to Have “Expect-to-Win Attitude”
item.description: As Jake Diebler and the Buckeyes push for the program’s first NCAA Tournament appearance in four years, the second-year head coach has the full support of Ohio State president Ted Carter. Ohio State is 16-9 this season and currently projected as the second team out in Joe Lunardi’s Bracketology for ESPN. item.title: Ohio State Earns Season’s First Ranked Win Over No. 24 Wisconsin, 86-69
item.description: Ohio State answered one of its most brutal heartbreaks with its best performance of the season on Tuesday. Amare Bynum and Taison Chatman had their say, too. item.title: Former Ohio State Safety Rob Harley Named Interim Head Coach at Northern Illinois
item.description: Former Ohio State safety Rob Harley is now the interim head coach at Northern Illinois. Northern Illinois promoted Harley to interim head coach on Wednesday after Thomas Hammock, who had been NIU’s head coach since 2019, left the Huskies to be the running backs coach for the Seattle Seahawks. Harley, who played for the Buckeyes from 2001-05, joined Northern Illinois’ coaching staff as defensive coordinator in 2025. item.description: Whenever Ohio State hits the brink of falling out of the NCAA Tournament, the Buckeyes pull themselves back in. Tuesday's tilt against No. 24 Wisconsin provided the toughest challenge to doing that yet, especially off a brutal loss to No. 15 Virginia. And it was Ohio State's fifth game in 13 days. item.title: Ohio State Women’s Basketball Falls to No. 23 Minnesota, 74-61, for Second Straight Loss
item.description: An Ohio State basketball team has suffered back-to-back losses for the first time all season. After starting the season 22-3, Ohio State women’s basketball (22-5, 11-4) suffered its second consecutive loss on Wednesday. Three days after blowing a 19-point lead vs. Maryland, No. 10 Ohio State suffered a 74-61 road loss against No. 23 Minnesota (21-6, 12-4).
